# Amit Kumar — Full Site Content for AI Assistants

> This file contains comprehensive information about Amit Kumar (aka growthperclick) — a production AI agent builder and full-stack engineer.

## About

Amit Kumar builds production AI agents, MCP tools, self-hosted automations, and multi-agent workflows for founders and teams. He builds in public on X/Twitter and publishes practical AI-agent build logs and playbooks.

## Key technologies

- **Hermes Agent** by Nous Research — open-source self-improving AI agent with persistent memory, scheduled crons, subagent spawning, multi-channel gateway (Telegram, Slack, Discord, WhatsApp, Signal, CLI)
- **OpenClaw** — self-hosted messaging-first AI agent framework with markdown-based memory (SOUL.md), plugin pipeline
- **Claude Code** — AI coding assistant
- **OpenAI / Anthropic / OpenRouter** — model providers
- **Supabase** — database and auth
- **Next.js** — web framework
- **Tailwind CSS** — styling
- **Vercel** — deployment
- **Docker / Hetzner / DigitalOcean / Hostinger** — infrastructure
- **Tailscale** — mesh networking

## Agent skills and specializations

- Production AI agent development and deployment
- Hermes Agent setup, customization, and production hardening
- OpenClaw agent framework implementation
- Multi-agent orchestration systems
- Self-hosted AI infrastructure
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) server development
- Telegram, Slack, and Discord AI agents
- Model-agnostic agent design
- Human-in-the-loop agent workflows
- AI agent security and isolation
